title: German Bratwurst Rillettes Crostini
description: A twist on traditional German Bratwurst, served with rillettes made from the same delicious sausage. Perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of dough, about 3 inches on each side.
Place a small piece of Bratwurst on each square.
Top with a spoonful of rillettes.
Sprinkle with a pinch of French mustard.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle.
Brush the edges with a little water.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
